about: The source of docs/agents/parts.md (node scripts/agents/parts-list.mjs write). parts: the editor's parts (group part) and shared pieces (group shared), described by hand; every other UI file is listed from the code. screens: a description for a screen file whose leading comment does not say what it is for. Keys per entry: id, name, group, for, notFor, use, variants, files, copies.

parts.name: Button
parts.for: Any action a person clicks: a filled primary action or a quiet secondary one, with words and optionally an icon.
parts.notFor: A link that leaves the editor (use `link()` beside it), or an icon alone (no icon button part yet: see Copies to swap).
parts.use: `button(text, action, className = "button secondary")` from `src/ui/dom.ts`; `link(text, href, className = "button primary")` for an `<a>` with the same look. A screen that needs it to differ sets a `--btn-*` hook in its own CSS.
parts.variants: tone: primary (class `button` or `button primary`), secondary (`button secondary`, the default of `button()`); disabled is plain, not a pale tone
parts.copies: buttons made with `node("button")` and button looks styled in screens (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report`); `.icon-button` and `.text-button` in `src/style.css` are the next parts to make (icon button, text button).

parts.name: Icon
parts.for: A Phosphor Regular icon by name, alone or standing before or after words.
parts.use: `iconPart(name, { size, place, words })` from `src/ui/parts/icon.ts`; the screens still call `icon(name, size, className)` from `src/icons.ts` until the Icon swap.

parts.name: Spinner
parts.for: A ring turning while something loads, inline or as an overlay over the panel that is loading.
parts.notFor: A control as small as its ring (overlay), or progress that can be measured (use the Progress bar).
parts.use: `spinner({ size, place, label })` from `src/ui/parts/spinner.ts`; the caller marks the loading host `aria-busy="true"` and `inert`.

parts.name: Progress bar
parts.for: A bar that fills as far as a value says, or slides while nobody can tell how long it takes.
parts.use: `progress({ value, max, label })` from `src/ui/parts/progress.ts`; move a bar already on the page with `setProgress(bar, options)` so it animates.

parts.name: Badge
parts.for: A count, a status, a tag, a dot or a round mark, in one of six tones.
parts.use: `badgePart({ kind, tone, words, icon })` from `src/ui/parts/badge.ts`, or `badgeMarkup(options)` from `src/ui/parts/badge-options.ts` for markup text.
parts.copies: the shared `.badge` in `src/style.css` and the badge looks screens style themselves (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report`).

parts.name: Section heading
parts.for: Small uppercase words naming a group in a panel or menu, with an optional end slot for a count or a button.
parts.use: `sectionHeadingPart(words, { level, end })` from `src/ui/parts/section-heading.ts`.

parts.name: Keyboard key
parts.for: A key cap, or several keys pressed together, in a menu row, a tooltip or the shortcuts sheet.
parts.use: `keyPart(keys)` from `src/ui/parts/key.ts` (a string or a list of keys).

parts.name: Inline field
parts.for: A text value in a panel row that reads as plain text and becomes a field on focus, with a red underline for an error.
parts.use: class `inline-field` on the input; the panels listed at the top of `src/ui/inline-field.css` get it by selector.

parts.name: Shared values
parts.for: The colours (light and dark), spacing, type sizes, corners, shadows and timings every part and screen styles with.
parts.use: `var(--token)` in CSS; never a hand-typed px, colour or duration (the one-offs count, `scripts/agents/one-offs.mjs`, and `scripts/check-colours.mjs` hold this).

parts.name: Dropdown
parts.for: A menu that opens under its button (nonmodal): opening, closing on Escape and outside click, focus, placement.
parts.use: `mountDropdown({ … })` from `src/components/dropdown.ts`.

parts.name: Flyout
parts.for: A submenu beside a dropdown, opened from one of its rows.
parts.use: `mountFlyout({ … })` from `src/components/flyout.ts`.

parts.name: Row menu
parts.for: A menu of actions for one row (a page, a file, an element): items with an icon, a hint key, a disabled reason.
parts.use: `createRowMenu(host, onClose)` from `src/components/row-menu.ts`, items as `MenuItem`.

parts.name: Confirm dialog
parts.for: A modal question before an action that cannot be undone: a title, notes, the action and Cancel.
parts.use: `createConfirmDialog(id)` from `src/components/confirm-dialog.ts`. Its look is the create dialog's (`src/components/create-dialog.css`).
parts.copies: dialogs made by hand and their backdrops (`node scripts/agents/copies.mjs report`); one Dialog part is planned.

parts.name: Field suggestions
parts.for: A suggestion list anchored to a text field (a URL's pages, an image's files), with keyboard choice.
parts.use: `attachFieldSuggestions(input, entries, label)` from `src/components/field-suggestions.ts`; rows from `suggestionLines()` in `src/components/suggestion-rows.ts`.

parts.name: Resize handle
parts.for: A splitter that resizes a panel by drag and toggles it by click or key.
parts.use: `createGrip()` and `trackPress(handle, handlers)` from `src/components/resize-handle.ts`.

parts.name: Spotlight
parts.for: Dims the page, rings one element and shows a callout beside it with a title, text and buttons.
parts.use: `spotlight(target, options)` from `src/components/spotlight.ts`; placement in `src/components/spotlight-layout.ts`.

parts.name: Refusal note
parts.for: Says why an action cannot run, next to the control that was used.
parts.use: `refuse(reason, near)` from `src/components/refusal-note.ts`.

parts.name: Done mark
parts.for: Shows a finished action on the menu button that ran it: its icon turns into a check for a moment.
parts.use: `markDone(control, ms)` from `src/ui/done-mark.ts`.

parts.name: Person chip
parts.for: Someone in a synced session by initial, in the top bar and on the guest page.
parts.use: class `person-chip` (and `person-chip--more` for the rest count).

parts.name: Found announcer
parts.for: Tells a screen reader what a search found once the typing rests.
parts.use: `sayFound(region, text)` and `foundCount(count, noun)` from `src/ui/say-found.ts`.

parts.name: Media form fields
parts.for: A labelled text field, select or tick box (with an optional hint line) in the Media screens' sheets.
parts.use: `input(label, type)`, `select(label, choices)`, `field(label, control)`, `check(label, control, hint)` from `src/page-builder/media-library-fields.ts`.

parts.name: Editor scrollbars
parts.for: The thin scrollbars of the editor's own panels.

screens.src/components/sidebar-resize.ts: The sidebar's width: the handle on its right edge resizes when dragged and hides or shows the sidebar when clicked.
screens.src/components/site-settings.ts: The Site settings dialog: the site's name, address, favicon and social image.
screens.src/native-settings.ts: Opens the Site settings dialog and writes what it changes into the site's files.
screens.src/page-builder/improve-images.ts: The Improve images screen in Media: heavy pictures to make lighter, and the ones Lex left alone.
screens.src/page-builder/media-files-adding.ts: Files dropped on a Files folder or chosen with Upload files: each row's progress and Cancel.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-adding.ts: Adding files to Media: the Optimise sheet's choices, the save, and the grid read again after.
The Clean up review in Media: groups of older copies and unused files to remove, with Undo.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-delete.ts: Remove file in Media: its own screen with Back, naming the pages that still use the file.
The Optimise sheet in Media: size, quality and folder for new files before they are saved.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-shell.ts: The Media library's frame: header, the One bar, grid, selection bar, sheet and footer.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-view.ts: The Media pane, or the Choose image dialog: the library's grid, details and sheets together.
screens.src/page-builder/media-markup.ts: The markup a picture or video gets when placed on a page: sizes, sources and the player.
screens.src/page-builder/media-picker.ts: The Media picker's data: the library's files, online videos and what each one is used for.
screens.src/agent-media.ts: Lists and previews the site's media files for agents (the MCP media tools).
screens.src/components/block-rail.ts: The block rail beside the canvas: the blocks to add, and the Add toggle that opens the Add panel.
screens.src/components/slot-ghosts.ts: Ghost outlines of a component's slots on the canvas, from the preview's report of where each slot sits.
screens.src/theme.ts: Hands the theme's colours to what cannot read CSS variables (Monaco, the preview overlay) and keeps them in step.
screens.src/page-builder/native-elements.ts: The markup of the plain elements the rail adds (section, div, heading, paragraph, media, button), with their checks.
screens.src/page-builder/site-navigation.ts: Reads and edits the site's navigation links in the page source.
screens.src/page-builder/pdf-preview.ts: A PDF download's first page as a preview picture, sized to fit.
screens.src/page-builder/improve-gifs-players.ts: Improve images for GIFs: turns them into looping videos with the site's player.
screens.src/page-builder/looping-video.ts: The markup of a looping, background or placed video in the page source.
screens.src/page-builder/media-transparency.ts: Whether a picture has see-through pixels, so it is never turned into a format that cannot keep them.
screens.src/page-builder/media-attributes.ts: Reads a picture's attributes (such as its existing alt text) from page markup.
screens.src/page-builder/component-shapes.ts: A component's shape on the canvas (picture, frame, popup), read from its template.
screens.src/controllers/files-tree-controller.ts: The Files tab's tree: folders opened, rows listed and kept in step with the branch.
screens.src/controllers/page-structure-controlle: The Page structure sidebar's wiring to the workspace: selection, edits and refreshes.
screens.src/outside-merge.ts: Folds changes made outside the editor (on GitHub) into the open drafts.
screens.src/page-builder/player-markup.ts: The markup of a video or audio player and its subtitles in the page source.
screens.src/page-builder/online-video.ts: YouTube and Vimeo videos: their address checks, records and still pictures.
screens.src/page-builder/media-page-markup.ts: The page edits that place a media file: its path, priority and sizes.
screens.src/components/file-row-actions.ts: The Files tree's row actions: the ⋯ button and right-click menu, rename, delete, and moving or uploading by drag.
screens.src/components/page-picker.ts: Picks where a new page goes: under which page in the site's tree.
screens.src/components/pages-tree.ts: The explorer's Pages tab: the site's pages as a tree, with new page and rename.
screens.src/components/card-grid-controls.ts: Add card and New page + card under a grid of cards on the canvas.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-grid.ts: Draws the Media library's grid of tiles for the current search, kind and collection.
screens.src/page-builder/media-place.ts: Swaps the picture at a place on a page for a chosen file, as one Undo step.
The splitter that resizes the component panel.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-collectio: The Media library's collection screens: manage, name and delete a collection.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-recently-: Recently removed in Media: files removed lately, to bring back.
To check in Media: each description an agent wrote, with its picture, to accept (Looks right) or Edit.
screens.src/page-builder/media-adding-settings.t: Adding settings in Media: how new files are prepared when they are added.
screens.src/page-builder/media-library-improve.t: Opens Improve images from the Media library and keeps its Undo list.
screens.src/components/repository-menu.ts: The project menu under the project tile: repositories, branches, site settings, sharing, download and sign out.
screens.src/components/publish-menu.ts: The Save menu: the changes to save or publish, each with its comparison, and Discard.
screens.src/page-builder/media-clean-up-review.t: The Clean up review's words and sizes: titles, lines and byte counts for each group.
screens.src/page-builder/media-adding-summary.ts: The summary while files are added: one row per file with its progress.
screens.src/page-builder/media-busy-lock.ts: Media's busy lock: one image change at a time, the screen marked busy meanwhile, and the Cancel or Close button (`cancellation()`) a running change offers.
